route.label: Approval route
route.letter: No approval: the letter is registered at once

memo: The document gets a number like СЗ-2026/031 and goes to the director for approval.
The director approves, returns it for rework or rejects it — you get a notification.
An approved document stays in “My documents” with the visa and date.
memoAmount: The document gets a number like СЗ-2026/031 and goes to the director for approval.
After the director approves, the document is passed to the accountant for payment.
The accountant confirms payment: the status becomes “Paid”.
application: The application gets a number like ЗЯ-2026/012 and goes to the director for approval.
The director approves, returns it for rework or rejects it — you get a notification.
The decision and its date stay in “My documents”.
report: The report gets a number like ОТ-2026/007 and goes to the director for approval.
The director approves, returns it for rework or rejects it — you get a notification.
The decision and its date stay in “My documents”.
letter: The letter gets the outgoing number ИСХ-NNN/YY and the registration date.
The numbered letterhead PDF goes to the addressee by email, if given.
A reply “to ВХ” closes the “Prepare a reply” instruction; the sending log is on the letter card.
consequence.draft: “Save draft” sends nothing: the document stays in “My documents” with a “Continue” button.
letterHandover: The letter draft goes to the records clerk for registration.
They check the PDF, register the outgoing number and send it to the addressee.
The outgoing number and the sending log appear on the letter card.
